sections.content:
Owner principle (2026-07-31): the core relation set should be as small as possible — but not smaller. Explicitly capability-based, NOT usage-based: the current census (relation graphs in both live repos are 100% document structure; five of seven core types have zero instances) is corroborating colour, not the decision basis — a young corpus not using `evidences` says nothing about whether a mature federation needs it.

PROPOSED CRITERION: a relation type belongs in core iff a core mechanism depends on it — removing it would leave a dangling dependency inside the substrate. Interop does not require core membership (definitions are UUID-anchored and travel with packages); core buys guaranteed presence, and only mechanisms need a guarantee.

Applied: CORE = precedes (R6 ordering engine), contains (container traversal I-66, navigation, discovery I-118), supersedes (record successor, RFC-022 definitional state, R11 lineage), derived-from (R11 graduation lineage, RFC-023 mapping — mechanism currently unfired, srs-rust#779). NOT CORE = refines, evidences, depends-on (no mechanism consumes them) — proposed home: a `recommended` relation package installed by default at repo create, removable; same UUIDs, same interop, presence becomes a choice rather than a false guarantee.

'Not smaller' check: drop any of the four and a core mechanism loses its edge type; going below four requires deleting mechanisms. Four is the fixed point.

Deliberately NOT grown into core: the deliberation family (contradicts/objects-to, amends, ratifies, delegates, responds-to) — the most important missing vocabulary (dissent is currently unrepresentable) but domain semantics; home is a governance package owned by the muDemocracy layer. muSrs inventing `delegates` locally (muDemocracy#134) is this need surfacing without a home.

Competitive note: the differentiator vs untyped-link formats is not vocabulary size but the AI-assert-then-human-ratify loop (assertedBy: ai + confidence + status: proposed -> human accept/reject), which needs zero new schema and would be the first consumer of the entire provenance surface.

Decision asks pending owner on srs#171: (a) ratify the criterion; (b) approve the 4+3 split and the recommended package; (c) charter the governance relation package; (d) sequence the ratify loop. Graduate this note to a design-note record when ratified.
